title: The allergy interlock
subtitle: A sepsis bundle is applied whole or not at all

steps.caption: Orders, then Order sets: cited protocols. Every item still goes through the allergy interlock, the dose guard and terminology validation.
Pick Sepsis Six. The gates are patient-specific, so there is nothing honest to show until Orb knows whose chart this is.
Apply to Suresh Reddy, 55, community-acquired pneumonia with early sepsis.
Eight items clear. Ceftriaxone is STOPPED: a documented anaphylaxis to IV ceftriaxone in 2023. The Apply button is disabled, because a half-applied sepsis bundle is its own emergency.
Same set, different patient: Ananya Kapoor has a moderate penicillin rash. Orb raises a cross-reactivity alert but does not block. Four patients, four different answers.
